ns2:course.label: Learning in Community
ns2:course.description: Service-learning dedicated to benefiting nonprofit organizations. Learning through inquiry, acquisition of skills and knowledge to address projects, and development of project and team skills. Student teams work on a project of importance proposed by and in partnership with each organization. Projects vary by term. See Class Schedule. May be repeated in the same term to a maximum of 6 hours. May be repeated in separate terms to a maximum of 12 hours.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: May be repeated in the same term to a maximum of 6 hours. May be repeated in separate terms to a maximum of 12 hours.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: Each section is a different topic and project, so please refer to the LINC website (linc.illinois.edu) to select a specific section, day, and time.
